headline: Enrolment messages that send themselves
alt: Modern Enrolment Notifier for Moodle 4.5–5.2 — rules for enrolment, expiry and completion across five delivery channels, queued on cron.

headline: One rule engine for the whole lifecycle
alt: Notification rules for enrolment, expiry and completion events, scoped site-wide, to a category or one course.

headline: Zero manual chase
alt: Rule presets — one-click starters for learner welcome, teacher alert, expiry reminder, completion congratulations and manager digest.

headline: Five delivery channels
alt: Email, Moodle message, webhook, Slack and Microsoft Teams per rule, with HMAC-signed webhooks and a live channel test.

headline: Branded templates, drafted by AI
alt: 20 branded HTML templates with placeholders and live preview, plus optional AI drafting via Moodle's AI subsystem.

headline: Reach the right recipients
alt: Send to learner, teachers, course managers, contacts or line manager; resolve managers by role, profile field or manual table.

headline: Get Modern Enrolment Notifier
alt: Get Modern Enrolment Notifier — rule-based enrolment, expiry and completion notifications for Moodle 4.5–5.2.
